notes.title: Game Ui update - New death screen
Player model and game difficulty changes
notes.content:
After reading some of you guys reviews, I have decided to update on a few things to improve the game quality and performance.
[b]Here is what I have done:[/b]
+ Rendering the player model bigger so the player can see everything clearly.
+ Adjusting the game difficulties 
+ Reduce the spawnrate of some enemies
+ Adding a better game guide in the how-to-play menu
